field.label: Enabled
field.help: Disable to keep this profile without offering it as a routing target.

field.label: Name
field.help: Label used to refer to this upstream in policy rules and in the generated config.

field.label: NextDNS profile ID (quick-add)
field.help: Paste just the NextDNS profile ID (e.g. abc123) to auto-fill the type/endpoint fields below as https://dns.nextdns.io/<id> with type doh3. Leave blank for a non-NextDNS upstream.

field.label: Type
field.help: doh3 is NextDNS's recommended protocol; use dot or legacy only for upstreams that don't support DNS-over-HTTPS.

field.label: Endpoint
field.help: URL for doh/doh3 upstreams, host[:port] for dot/legacy upstreams.

field.label: Timeout (ms)
field.help: How long ctrld waits for this upstream to respond before treating the query as failed.
